THE LONG BEACH COMMUNITY
  INVESTMENT COMPANY AGENDA
  WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 21, 2024
  411 W. OCEAN BOULEVARD
  BEACH CONFERENCE ROOM, 2ND FLOOR, 4:00 PM

Hilda Delgado, Vice Chair  Eva Melgarejo, Director
Hakim Chambers, Director  Alejandra Ramirez, Director
Jasmine Esparza, Director  Elwood Sides, Director

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL COMMENTS TO
  MONICA.JAIME@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54563  Recommendation to receive and file President’s Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54564  Recommendation to approve the minutes for The Long Beach Community
  Investment Company special meeting of Wednesday, June 5, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-54566  Recommendation to approve a $550,000 increase to the HOME loan to Century
  Affordable Development, Inc. (Century) for the development of 90 Veteran
  Affordable Housing Units located at 2121 W. Williams Street;

  Authorize the President to negotiate an Amendment to the Affordable Housing Loan
  Agreement with Century; and

  Authorize the President or designee to negotiate and execute any and all
  documents necessary related to the Loan Amendment.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-54567  Recommendation to approve a HOME loan in the amount of $2,000,000 to
  Jamboree Housing Corporation (Jamboree) for the development of 101 East Pacific
  Coast Highway;

  Authorize the President to negotiate the Affordable Housing Loan Agreement with
  Jamboree; and

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-54568  Recommendation to approve a loan in the amount of up to $5 Million to Mercy
  Housing California (Mercy) for the development of affordable rental housing units
  located at 300 Alamitos Avenue;

  Authorize the President to negotiate an Affordable Housing Loan Agreement with
  Mercy; and

  Authorize the President or designee to execute any and all documents necessary to
  implement the Loan Agreement.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address The Long Beach Community Investment Company on non-agenda items.
Each speaker is limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Monica Jaime, Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior to the
meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact (562) 570-3807 or (562) 570-6957.
